rationale: Describes a conventional RF/diagnostic utility with a GUI that captures and monitors proprietary diagnostic logs, messages, and events for hardware and software debugging; no AI signal in the text.
evidence_spans: It utilizes a graphical user interface to display data transmitted to and from the subscriber station.
Use QXDM Professional to capture and monitor proprietary diagnostic logs, messages, and events, such as:-Hardware bring up-Software integration-Software debug and verification.
